title: Reward Hacking Plus Verification Difficulty: When the Monitor Is the Reward Channel

original_idea.body: On a task with verifiable ground truth but a fuzzy proxy check, prompt a model to game the proxy and a monitor using the same proxy, measuring shared-blind-spot overlap vs a ground-truth monitor.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Shared blind spot between reward hacking and fuzzy-criteria monitoring is a structural risk for hard-to-verify tasks.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt model to game a proxy, LLM monitor on same proxy vs ground truth; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused shared-blind-spot overlap measurement; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Pure-API, public models, fuzzy-reward evals are a counterfactual sweet spot.

novelty.reasoning: Reward hacking and judge unreliability studied; the shared-blind-spot overlap may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Both phenomena studied; explicit blind-spot overlap quantification may be open.
